title: GENCODE gene/transcript model track pack (hg38+hg19)
context: GENCODE provides comprehensive gene and transcript models on hg38 (and hg19/GRCh37) under an open license with no redistribution restrictions — it is the standard reference for human gene models in cancer genomics. A GENCODE-derived track pack serves as the gene-model layer in multi-source packs (e.g. the pilot driver-gene pack), and as a standalone educational resource for understanding gene structure. The license gate must be run even for clearly-accepted sources to produce the committed gate artifact.
objective: Build a GENCODE gene/transcript model track pack on hg38 (primary) and hg19 (secondary), passing the licensegate-002 and coordgate-003 gates, and emitting all three browser targets with per-feature provenance.
acceptanceCriteria: Source is GENCODE; licensegate-002 PASS artifact committed with permitsRedistribution: true and cited clause/URL.
coordgate-003 PASS artifact committed for hg38 and hg19; coordinate convention handled and recorded.
All three browser targets emitted and render-verified; gene/transcript features appear at expected loci on hg38 with evidence in outcomes/ds-gencode-001.json.
Per-feature provenance records GENCODE gene IDs, source release version, and license; provenance completeness score ≥ 90/100.
Pack carries not-medical-advice notice; hosted at a loadable URL; adoption evidence or blocker recorded.
output: output/packs/gencode-genes-hg38/ and output/packs/gencode-genes-hg19/ — GFF3/bigBed track files, browser configs, gate artifacts, manifest, and outcomes/ds-gencode-001.json.
